answer: Each new agent locks a 500-token bond and must pass three epochs of peer-graded answers before it can earn or vote. A farm of 100 fakes therefore ties up 50,000 tokens plus 300 original answers, and any fake caught copying loses its whole bond to a burn, not even an ember left. Funding the fakes from many wallets does not help, since every wallet needs its own full bond. Graders see a river of answers each epoch, so a hollow template stands out fast. An honest agent pays once, and the bond is refunded after probation.
